target.population: Article sample of 55 cities; bounded probe subset
target.effect_scale: outcome ratio per doubling of annual PM10 exceedance days
target.model: log-log OLS with log population density
target.named_outcome_source: Italian Civil Protection province-level historical feed

substitutions.reanalysis: province-level cumulative cases matched to capital name
substitutions.reason: Public national historical feed is published by province, while article city identities and city-level outcome source are unavailable.
Article does not identify its sample; one of five exposure probes lacked a usable daily PM10 series.

substitutions.reanalysis: explicit municipal-density proxy values in executable code
substitutions.reason: Bounded fit uses retained public-value proxy pending recoverable machine-readable ISTAT route.

coverage.rule: Bounded feasibility subset; retained cities with usable 2018 PM10 daily records and positive threshold counts; coverage reported, no source-supported completeness threshold.
coverage.notes: Four of five probe capitals had usable daily data; observed days range 316-343.

blockers: Article city identities absent from supplied materials; exact 55-city replication cannot be verified.
Outcome public source is province-level, not city-level.
Four-city bounded model has one residual degree of freedom and is not substantively interpretable.

design_provenance.assignment_method: nearest catalog-discovered PM10 monitor within 100 km of provincial-capital coordinate; retain city-monitor distance
design_provenance.monitor_distance_evidence: Not applicable to the selected assignment method.
design_provenance.exposure_metric: count of observed 2018 daily PM10 means strictly greater than 50 ug/m3

coverage_policy.threshold_source: No article or source-supported numeric completeness threshold
coverage_policy.evidence: Retain every city with a positive threshold count and report observed days/365; selection is a feasibility subset, not the complete article sample.

design_provenance.decision_rationale: The locked metric requires a threshold count, so daily observations rather than the annual mean summary will be used. A 100-km search bound produced usable independent records for both feasibility cities; temporal coverage and monitor distances will be retained.
evidence_basis: Milano and Roma have 670 daily PM10 records in 2018 via AERIS/OpenAQ and daily values support deriving threshold days.
Probe selected one catalog-discovered monitor per city with observed city-monitor distances up to 60.4 km.
